parameters.query:
INSERT INTO projects (source, source_id, title, naics, state, value, posted_at, deadline)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.source_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.naics || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.state || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.value === null || $json.value === undefined || $json.value === '' ? 'NULL' : $json.value }},
  {{ $json.posted_at ? "'" + $json.posted_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.deadline ? "'" + $json.deadline + "'" : 'NULL' }}
)
ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO NOTHING;
